> Not a problem in the PR, but we really need a means of storing the actual programs built. Because while this works, it _won't_ capture the dependencies exclusive to the Windows console subsystem when using `windows_subsystem=gui`.

Yeah, I know, it's really annoying - on the consoles builds, we also produce more than one "program", and not being able to have a reference to those outside of where they're defined is really annoying, I would like to be able to create more than one vcxproj, one for each binary produced by the build system.
